bio_draft: VANI (Vani Dewan) is an open-format DJ based in California who grew up in Los Angeles and blends afrobeats, baile funk, desi fusion, bass house and hardgroove. She is also a doctoral researcher at USC's Brain and Creativity Institute, and has supported Jyoty, Zeemuffin, Flowdan, Mastane, KSHMR and DJ ADHD in the US and Asia, including an India tour.

bio_sources.fact: grew up in Los Angeles; doctoral researcher at USC's Brain and Creativity Institute; genres

notes: No releases found (she is a DJ). No other mixes found beyond the NDCR set; search budget ran out before a deeper look at her SoundCloud. The NDCR description also lists Priya Ragu among acts she opened for or played with; RA does not. Not to be confused with Vani Vachi (Prague/Whole festival) or 'Served by VaNi' (South Africa). Mixmag Asia says her debut HEAT MAP party was in LA on 12 Sep 2026.

south_asian.evidence: Mixmag Asia quotes her: 'Everything I do is in reverence to my South Asian identity'; she grew up on Bollywood, classical and Sufi music.

bio_draft: Dameer (Dameer Khan) is a Bangladeshi singer, producer and DJ, born in Dhaka and now based in Montreal. He started as an indie singer-songwriter, signed to the German label Majestic Casual at 17, and now DJs house and techno sets that remix 70s to 90s Bengali classics and runs Bengali raves.
